EXG4-006.name: Distant Sea's Extreme
EXG4-006.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When your deck becomes zero due to opposing effects, you can immediately use this card, return every card in your Trash and all your banished cards to the deck and shuffle it. Also, during this turn, your deck is unaffected by opposing effects. These effects can't be prevented by either player's effects.

[Flash]
Except for on field effects, negate every opposing effect that is active, and immediately end this turn.

EXG5-002.name: Forbidden Extreme
EXG5-002.effect:
This card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When the number of cards in your deck becomes zero due to the opponent, you can immediately use the following effect.

█ Return all your banished cards and cards in your Trash to the deck and shuffle it. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +2.

EXG4-004.name: Freezing Blizzard's Extreme
EXG4-004.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, and this card can't be used on Your Turn.

When your deck would be discarded by opposing effects, or when your Life would become zero due to the opponent, by banishing this card from game, immediately end this turn. Also, when your Life would become zero, your Life would become one and the cores would be sent to the Reserve. Neither player can activate effects/Burst effects via this effect.

EXG4-005.name: Heaven Revelation's Extreme
EXG4-005.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

When your deck becomes zero due to opposing effects, you can immediately use this card, return every card in your Trash and all your banished cards to the deck and shuffle it. Also, during this turn, your deck is unaffected by opposing effects. These effects can't be prevented by either player's effects.

[Flash]
During this turn, even if your Life reaches zero, you don't lose. Also, at the End Step of this turn, put cores from the Void to your Life until your have three Lives.

EXG4-002.name: Purple Flash's Extreme
EXG4-002.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

[Flash]
Treat this card as colorless, and send all cores from every opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the Reserve. Then, during this turn, increase the LV cost of every opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus by +2.

EXG4-001.name: Raging Flame's Extreme
EXG4-001.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

[Flash]
Target a non-braved Spirit/Ultimate you control, and every other Spirit/Ultimate. The effects of the Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect can't activate, and Braves can't remain on the Field. These effect can't be prevented by either player's effects.

EXG4-003.name: Rich Harvest's Extreme
EXG4-003.effect:
This card and you are unaffected by any effect other than this card's effect, this card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

[Flash]
Heavy exhaust every opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, send every opposing exhausted Spirit/Ultimate to the Removed Zone.
[heb]
After this effect resolves, if the opponent controls any Spirit/Ultimate, during this turn, your Life won't be brought to less than two.

EXG5-006.name: Severance Extreme
EXG5-006.effect:
This card can't be used on Your Turn, and is banished from the game after its effect resolves.

[Flash]
Exhaust every opposing Spirit/Ultimate. Then, negate every opposing active effect, and immediately end this turn.

P17-EXG03.name: The ExtremeKingTiger Jiu-Dian
P17-EXG03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Exhaust three opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Five cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], exhaust any number of opposing Spirits/Ultimates. During this game, opposing Spirits/Ultimates that are exhausted at this point can't refresh. After this effect resolves, banish all cards in the opposing Trash. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.

P17-EXG04.name: The ExtremeMachineDeity Cry-Notis
P17-EXG04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Discard an opposing Burst.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Three cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], return all opposing Spirits/Ultimates/Nexuses to the Hand. When Brave Spirits/Brave Ultimates are returned to the Hand by this effect, the Braves can't remain on the Field. Then, immediately end the battle. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.

P17-EXG02.name: The ExtremeCount Plenus
P17-EXG02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw two cards.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Three cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], discard cards from the opposing Hand until only two cards left. For each card discarded by this effect, send a core from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to their Reserve. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.

P17-EXG01.name: The ExtremeDragonDeity Extreme Dragon
P17-EXG01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - [Extreme Drive] (Opposing Attack Step)
If you banish cards until [Eight cards left in your Deck counting from deckbottom & 0 cards in your Trash], destroy every opposing 30000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Draw as many cards from your deck as you like up to the number of Spirits/Ultimates destroyed by this effect. [Extreme Drive] can only be used once per game.
